subject: Commit calibration: Q3 retention risk & stage refresh
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@brightbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 renewal - stage verification + requested evidence

Tom — following up on our renewal timeline for BrightByte. Finance is refreshing Q3 coverage and we need a quick stage check to avoid overstating commit. Can you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday: 

- Current signed seats vs. active seats (column B in the attached sheet)
- Any known procurement blockers (PO delay, legal review, SSO onboarding)
- Whether your CSM has scheduled a technical ROI review in April (yes/no)

I've attached the renewal-stage-sheet.xlsx with suggested stage moves highlighted in yellow. If anything is uncertain, mark as "needs validation" rather than keeping it at 100% commit.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the three items above or flag questions
2) If needed, we'll set a 15-min call with Marissa to align on support/technical blockers

Thanks — want to make sure this account is properly reflected in the forecast.

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@brightbyte.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightByte Finance <finance@brightbyte.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal - stage verification + requested evidence

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the sheet and the callout. Quick answers below and notes appended.

- Signed vs active seats: Signed 120, currently active 112 (8 pending activation due to onboarding).
- Procurement blockers: Finance is waiting on a customized SOC 2 appendix (legal) and a PO that should land in early April.
- CSM ROI review: Yes — tentative for Apr 6, pending legal appendix.

I marked rows 3, 7 and 12 in your sheet as "needs validation" where we have seat/usage ambiguity. I also attached our internal PO tracker as a reference.

If helpful, we can do a 15-min sync on Monday afternoon (Mar 22) — I cc'd our finance alias in case they want to chime in.

Tom
Tom Reyes
Head of Strategic Ops, BrightByte Analytics

Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Q3 renewal - stage verification + requested evidence

Team — I reviewed the BrightByte sheet and Tom's notes. Summary and recommended forecast actions below: 

Account snapshot (from Tom + usage data):
- Contract ARR: $1,080,000 annualized
- Active seats: 112 vs signed 120 (8 onboarding lag)
- Procurement ETA: PO expected Apr 4–8; legal appendix (SOC 2 customization) likely to add 2–3 business days of review

Risk assessment and recommended stage adjustments:
- Rows flagged "needs validation" (3,7,12): move to Stage: "Commit - pending validation" with probability 55% until seats activate or PO arrives
- For the main line item (primary product licence): keep at 80% commit, but move expected close date out two weeks to Apr 15 to reflect legal buffer
- Add a "churn-watch" flag for the smaller add-on (row 12) — usage shows declining month-over-month and the CSM is seeing lower engagement

Action items:
1) Ben to own calling BrightByte finance to confirm PO timing and whether expedited billing cycle is possible (Ben) — due Mar 26
2) Naomi to show a revenue holdback scenario in the forecast model for Apr (reduce expected collection by 30% for items pending legal) — due Mar 26
3) Marissa to draft commit-calibration-notes and recommended probability deltas for RevOps — due Mar 25

I attached a short risk table I created. We'll use Jasmine's sheet as the source of truth and feed updates to the consolidated forecast.

-Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Commit calibration: Q3 retention risk & stage refresh

Thanks all — quick update and final calibration for the consolidated Q3 forecast.

What we changed: 
- Moved flagged rows 3, 7, 12 to "Commit - pending validation" with 55% probability.
- Primary licence probability set to 70% (previously modeled at 80%) and expected close moved to 2027-04-15.
- Added "churn-watch" tag to add-on (row 12) and set recovery probability at 35% unless engagement improves after the Apr 6 ROI review.

Attachments: commit-calibration-notes.pdf (explain rationale), updated-forecast.csv (revops adjusted model).

Next steps / owners:
- Ben: confirm PO arrival window and whether BrightByte can issue earlier payment terms (Ben) — check-in Apr 5
- Naomi: include the revised probabilities in the Apr 1 forecast snapshot and add a downside-scenario line (Naomi) — Apr 1
- Marissa: schedule the Apr 6 ROI review with the CSM and confirm engagement playbook availability (Marissa) — by Apr 1

Tom — thanks for the quick responses. If the PO comes in before Apr 6 we can uplist the main licence probability immediately. If not, we'll carry the adjusted figures into the April forecast submission to FinOps.

I'll update HubSpot and link the files to the BrightByte opportunity (links below).

—Jasmine
